transient_sightings.definition: Within adjacent same-player decisions, a fully transient opponent hero is absent at both endpoints but appears in intervening observations. Position-transient intervals also include positions absent at both endpoints when the hero itself is present. Distinct (handle, position) samples are counted within each interval, not as distinct episodes.
